# swiftui-tabs-ios (iOS 27.2) ground-truth fixtures

`examples/swiftui-tabs` (`scripts/build-ios-sim.sh examples/swiftui-tabs target/ios/Tabs.app dev.simcore.tabs`) on the iPhone 18 Pro
simulator, iOS 27.2: the 5 states and taps of `../../swiftui-tabs-ios/README.md`. Tab bar geometry is unchanged (a11y TabBar
0,791 402x83, items 94x54 at x 68/154/240); the selected item's capsule is (225,225,231) light and (10,10,10) dark (26.5:
233 / 58). Labels ink at y 832.7..839.3 on both releases.
